title: AntiAutoFishing
description: Prevent players from using an auto fishing mod.
body:
# AntiAutoFishing

AntiAutoFishing prevents players from using mods or scripts to fish while they are away from their keyboard. By tracking fishing activity, it triggers a mandatory verification menu that ensures players are present and manually interacting with the server, keeping your economy and gameplay fair.

## ⭐ Key Features
- Simple Threshold: Automatically triggers a verification check after a set amount of fish have been caught.
- Captcha Verification: Stops potential cheaters with a custom "Click the Item" verification window.
- Flexible Configuration: Decide exactly how many fish a player can catch before being tested and how many failed attempts are allowed before a kick.
- Protects your Economy: Prevents players from AFK-farming resources, keeping your server's item values consistent.
- Staff-Friendly: Runs quietly in the background, only interrupting gameplay when verification is required.

## ✏️ Commands
**/antiautofishing reload**
- Description: Reloads the plugin configuration.
- Permission: ANTIAUTOFISHING.RELOAD

## ✏️ Permissions
- ANTIAUTOFISHING.*: Grants access to all plugin commands and features.
- ANTIAUTOFISHING.RELOAD: Allows the user to reload the configuration file.
